title: Unreachable condition in Ack::from_bytes_for
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:340-341

Issue: The check `if n > WINDOW_SIZE { return Err(FragmentError::MalformedAck); }` can never be true.

Reasoning: `n = WINDOW_SIZE - trailing` where `trailing = bitmap.trailing_ones()`. Since `trailing` is a count of ones (non-negative) and `WINDOW_SIZE = 63`, the maximum value of `n` is exactly `WINDOW_SIZE` (when `trailing = 0`). Thus `n > WINDOW_SIZE` is mathematically impossible.

Impact: Dead code that may confuse readers or suggest defensive coding against an impossible scenario.

Suggested fix: Remove the check or add a comment explaining it as a safety assertion against future changes to the bitmap representation.
